name: Gaze of C'Thun jumps to a real ally, not the caster's companion (#9875)
contract: Gaze of C'Thun rank 1 500110 reads 'Set C'thun's Gaze upon an enemy or ally, jumping to 1 additional nearby
target, dealing Shadow damage to enemies or healing allies'. Its effects 0 and 1 are TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ANY
with EffectChainTarget 2, so the native chain search takes the closest unit of any kind within ten yards; a
spellbook companion such as Mechanical Squirrel 4055 (creature 2671, SUMMON_TYPE_MINIPET) follows at its
owner's feet and is closer than anyone else. A non-combat companion is neither an enemy nor an ally the
tooltip means, so with the cultist casting on itself, the companion at its side and an injured second player
about six yards away, the one jump must heal that player through 520335/520333. The ally is a player because
Unit::_IsValidAssistTarget refuses a player's assist on an ordinary creature without the raid-unit type flag,
so a friendly creature could never receive the heal whichever unit the jump selects.

steps.label: Stand the ally about six yards from the cultist
Let the companion settle at its owner's side
SETUP: the ally is within the ten-yard jump but beyond the companion
SETUP: the companion is the closest unit to the cultist
Gaze of C'Thun on the cultist itself
The primary target, the cultist, is healed
The jump heals the injured ally instead of the companion
